finalText:
**Real bug is in `refresh.js`, not `tokens.js`.**

Log points at [tokens.js:6](src/auth/tokens.js:6), `token.split('.')`. That's just the symptom.

Trace back: `resumeSession` at [session.js:7-8](src/session.js:7) calls `refreshToken(req.cookies.rt)`, then passes its result straight to `decode`.

Root cause is [refresh.js:14-16](src/auth/refresh.js:14): when `auth.internal` returns `invalid_grant` (a 400, not in `RECOVERABLE`), it swallows the error and returns `undefined` instead of throwing. That `undefined` flows into `decode`, which crashes on `.split`.

Open `refresh.js` first. `invalid_grant` should propagate as a real error, not a silent `undefined`.
